scope.summary: Align the payroll OpenAPI contract with tenant-bearer authentication and fail-closed authorization behavior already present in the payroll infrastructure runtime.
explicit_non_claims: No deployed payroll HTTP runtime is claimed.
No IAM/PDP implementation, storage adapter, or cloud service integration is added.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited.

domain_capability_matrix.lifecycle_operations: GREEN: payroll trial close, accounting journal draft, and HR leave impact intake operations are represented in contract and app tests.
domain_capability_matrix.tenant_project_account_isolation: GREEN: tenantId and legalEntityId are required in payroll request schemas and runtime cross-tenant tests exist.

domain_capability_matrix.billing_metering: YELLOW: payroll money amounts and financial data classes exist; service metering surface not inspected in this slice.

hyperscaler_lens.benchmark: AWS/GCP-class SaaS control planes document authentication and authorization failures as part of every tenant-scoped mutation contract.
hyperscaler_lens.improved_criterion: IAM/authz policy and control-plane API contract parity for payroll money mutations.
hyperscaler_lens.merge_conflict_resistance: Only domain-local payroll contract/test files plus a unique evidence file are changed.

facets.F1_correctness: Every payroll OpenAPI operation now exposes AuthenticationError and AuthorizationError response refs alongside ValidationError.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 payroll API contract test parses the checked-in OpenAPI contract and asserts tenantBearer plus 401/403 coverage for all operations.
facets.F3_maintainability: The guard is in the existing payroll API contract test target and uses serde_json already present in the target deps.
facets.F4_compatibility: Additive OpenAPI response documentation; no request schema, DTO, or runtime behavior changes.
facets.F5_security: Documents fail-closed unauthenticated and unauthorized outcomes for tenant-scoped payroll money mutations.
facets.F6_privacy: No new personal-data processing; existing financial/PII data classes remain unchanged.
facets.F7_operability: API consumers can distinguish validation, authentication, and authorization failures in the published contract.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path or dependency is added; the test reads one local contract file.
facets.F9_compliance: Supports payroll audit/privacy/compliance readiness by making auth failures explicit in the public API contract.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of an additive contract/test/evidence change.
facets.F11_observability: The new test failure names the method/path missing unauthenticated or unauthorized response documentation.
facets.F13_migration: Keeps provider-neutral Rust/API contract authority while avoiding shell, Python, CLI, or cloud-provider lock-in.
